**Subject:** Re: Amendment No. 2 draft  
**Date:** 2025-12-04  
**To:** Dana Okafor; June Osei-Lark

Dana, June—

I will not approve the 15% discount in the Amendment No. 2 draft. Quarrendon Freight Lines stays at 12% until renewal talks.

Please correct the discount line and resend the draft. A larger number appearing in a document is not, regrettably, an approval mechanism.
